Use case: compositing
Asset type: professional GitHub README hero / product presentation mockup.

Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the supplied DROIX product photograph of a black AYN Thor. Preserve the exact handheld, its open angle, camera perspective, chassis shape, hinge, bezels, every button and label, sticks, pale cyan stick rings, ports, surface materials, highlights and lighting.
Input image 2 is a SUPPORTING INSERT: a genuine unmodified Android emulator capture of Pokémon Emerald in Oldale Town. Use its existing pixel art and UI as screen content, not as inspiration for new artwork.

Replace only the two active display interiors on the handheld:
• Upper Thor display: insert the COMPLETE left gameplay rectangle from image 2, source pixels x=0 through 1066 and y=220 through 859. It includes the Pokémon Center, adjacent house, player, NPCs, trees, paths and small FPS counter. Exclude the screenshot's black letterbox outside that rectangle.
• Lower Thor display: insert the COMPLETE right touch-screen rectangle from image 2, source pixels x=1067 through 1919 and y=220 through 859. Include the entire Hoenn map, Oldale Town label and all eight right-side menu buttons, through SAVE and OPTION. Keep this content confined to the lower display between the physical controls.

Perspective-warp each whole rectangle to the corresponding glass display quadrilateral. Fill each active panel completely with the entire source content; use independent horizontal/vertical scaling as needed. Do not crop, zoom in, omit edges, repeat the gameplay on both displays, or remove any menu rows. Keep the source scene, text, pixel-art details, map and arrangement as faithful as possible. Screen content should remain crisp and bright, with only a subtle natural glass response; no glare that hides gameplay.

Present the complete unchanged handheld centered on a clean TRANSPARENT landscape canvas, approximately 3:2. Keep balanced clear margins around it and show the whole chassis. No props, invented logos, titles, captions, decorative graphics, colored background or watermark. This is a product mockup, not a photograph documenting hardware testing.
